text:
Sofia (Head of Private): Morning — starting a pilot for the "On-Prem Emergency Support Gateway" (ESG). ESG is an opt-in outbound-only support channel for Private/VPC customers that enables signed emergency hotfixes, short-lived diagnostic bundles, and an ephemeral jump-for-support flow. Pilot is limited to 6 customers. Signup + pilot docs: https://intranet.redwood/esg-pilot :rocket:
Tariq (Ops): Tech summary: outbound TLS to support.redwood.net using mTLS client certs assigned per-customer. No always-on agents; we run ephemeral collectors for the duration of a session. Hotfixes are uploaded as signed repair images and validated locally before application. Recommend a default 90-minute weekly maintenance window for applying non-critical hotfixes, configurable per customer.
Maya (Security): Telemetry rules for pilot: only anonymized metadata, signed hotfix hash, and session start/stop markers are sent. No customer payloads or model data leave the cluster. All hotfix artifacts must be signed via our KMS signing pipeline; we will publish attestations and SBOMs for each emergency image. Retention for pilot telemetry = 30 days. Internal compliance doc: https://intranet.redwood/security/esg-telemetry :lock:
Leah (Legal): We need a concise consent addendum for customers to opt into ESG. Template linked here — please review: https://legal.redwood/esg-consent-template. Also flag: customers wanting carveouts (no remote support) must sign specific waiver and accept SLA limitations.
CSM-bot: Creating pilot tickets for customers marked "ESG-interest" in CRM. Will ping assigned CSMs with onboarding checklist.
Tariq (Ops): Ops rollout plan (high-level):
```
1) Invite 6 pilot customers (week 0)
2) Run 2 staged sessions per customer (weeks 1-2)
3) Collect logs + signed hash lists, verify rollback paths (week 3)
4) Draft GA readiness and policy updates (week 4)
```
Also note: emergency patch flow has an automatic-health-check rollback if node-level latency or error rate jumps >7% within 10m.
Maya (Security): Action: adding ESG to the SOC artifacts pipeline. We'll produce: signed SBOM, attestation bundle, hotfix hash list, and session audit log. Customers requiring zero telemetry must use an offline repair image workflow and a longer SLA for manual recovery.
Leah (Legal): Decision: add a short clause to support contracts for "Emergency Support Gateway" opt-in, and an appendix for carveouts. I'll circulate redline by EOD Wednesday.
deploy-bot: ESG-preview v0.9 scheduled -> infra-staging at 2055004444
Sofia (Head of Private): Policy note: once ESG moves to GA we will require explicit written consent for emergency remote access for customers on our managed Private support tier. We'll provide a 45-day notice window before enforcing consent as a precondition of proactive emergency fixes. :warning:
Tariq (Ops): Customer-facing blurb draft: "Opting into ESG gives you access to expedited recovery workflows (signed hotfix images, guided remote diagnostics). If you decline, recovery will be manual and may incur longer RTOs. Contact your CSM to enroll or request an exemption."
CSM-bot: I'll attach onboarding checklist and rollback playbook to each pilot ticket.
Maya (Security): Please review the pilot telemetry scope and signoff matrix by Friday. If Security or Legal has blocking items, flag here.
Sofia (Head of Private): If anyone objects to the 45-day notice enforcement timeline or the default 90-minute maintenance window, please reply here before EOD Monday. Otherwise we'll finalize pilot invites tomorrow and start outreach. Thanks.
